notes: SoccerNet Ball Action Spotting broadcast footage is research/non-commercial. This tier is an EVALUATION BENCHMARK ONLY; SoccerNet ball-action video must never train shipped models or be redistributed with the product -- same licensing-boundaries posture CLAUDE.md and docs/implementation-status.md already record for SportsMOT (research-only tiers), applied here per SPO-47's brief.

Metric: this tier's ground truth (EventGroundTruth, pitchlab_core.event_gt) is scored with SoccerNet's ball-action-spotting metric, avg-mAP@1 (average precision over multiple tight tolerance windows around each event's true time), NOT IDF1/HOTA/purity -- those are for the track/box GroundTruth tiers (soccernet.json, sportsmot.json, soccertrack.json). The avg-mAP metric implementation itself is a separate, later task; this manifest only records the benchmark-data path SPO-47 built.

Data acquisition is out-of-band and NOT part of ingest: the raw SoccerNet Ball Action Spotting videos + Labels-ball.json files must be obtained per SoccerNet's own access process and placed under data/soccernet/ball/<split>/<match>/ before running `pitchlab-train ingest-soccernet-ball --split <split>`. No sequences are recorded below yet because none have been downloaded/ingested -- this is an intentionally empty starter manifest, not a gap.

OPEN CONCERN carried from packages/pitchlab_train/src/pitchlab_train/datasets/soccernet_ball.py's module docstring: the real dataset release is understood to package each match as two half-video files sharing one Labels-ball.json, not the single 'one video per match' layout the ingest adapter currently assumes (unverified -- this repo has no downloaded copy to check against). Verify and, if needed, extend the adapter before the first real ingest.

Unlike soccernet.json (soccernet-tracking), this file was not produced by `pitchlab_train.datasets.manifest.update_tier_manifest` -- it is hand-authored as a placeholder per SPO-47's brief. Once `ingest-soccernet-ball` is run for real, that ingest calls the same update_tier_manifest merge path as ingest-sportsmot/ingest-soccertrack and will populate `sequences` following this file's existing shape/determinism rules (see configs/datasets/README.md).
